$comment: What each package and React Native API does in a react-native-web build. Read by check-web-support.mjs (web-module-support, web-rn-api). Verified on 2026-10-14 by bundling every package for the web with Expo SDK 57 (npx expo export --platform web) and calling one API of each in headless Chrome (references/module-support.md has the method and re-verify steps), and by comparing react-native 0.86.3's exports and typings with react-native-web 0.21.3's sources (dist/exports/Alert has only alert, so Alert.prompt is undefined; dist/exports/I18nManager is { allowRTL() {}, forceRTL() {}, getConstants() { return { isRTL: false } } }). support: none = the import or its calls fail on the web (the checker fails a web-bundled import); partial = it loads and answers, but does nothing or less (documented, not failed); supported = works. Add an app's own packages under packages with the same fields.

react-native-google-mobile-ads.behaviour: the web bundle fails: Importing native-only module "react-native/Libraries/Utilities/codegenNativeComponent" on web
react-native-google-mobile-ads.fix: import it only from a .native.ts adapter (or give the adapter a .web.ts sibling that serves no ads)

expo-tracking-transparency.behaviour: the import throws in the browser: Cannot find native module 'ExpoTrackingTransparency'
expo-tracking-transparency.fix: give the consent adapter a .web.ts sibling (there is no tracking prompt on the web)

expo-iap.behaviour: calls throw: Cannot find native module 'ExpoIap'
expo-iap.fix: give the purchase adapter a .web.ts sibling that reports purchases as unavailable

expo-secure-store.behaviour: calls throw (getValueWithKeyAsync is not a function); isAvailableAsync() is false
expo-secure-store.fix: give the secure-storage adapter a .web.ts sibling: a session the server keeps in an httpOnly cookie, or memory only; never localStorage

expo-file-system.behaviour: calls throw (this.validatePath is not a function) after the warning "expo-file-system is not supported on web"
expo-file-system.fix: give the file adapter a .web.ts sibling (downloads through a link, uploads through expo-document-picker) or hide the feature on the web

expo-notifications.behaviour: getPermissionsAsync answers, but scheduleNotificationAsync throws (not available on web) and push-token listeners do nothing
expo-notifications.fix: give the notification adapter a .web.ts sibling that reports reminders as unsupported

expo-apple-authentication.behaviour: isAvailableAsync() is false; the button and sign-in exist only on iOS
expo-apple-authentication.fix: show Apple sign-in only when isAvailableAsync() is true; offer the OAuth web flow elsewhere

expo-store-review.behaviour: isAvailableAsync() is false; requestReview() warns and does nothing
expo-store-review.fix: ask for a review only on iOS and Android

expo-splash-screen.behaviour: preventAutoHideAsync() resolves false and hide() does nothing: there is no native splash on the web
expo-splash-screen.fix: nothing to do; the static HTML ground colour stands in for the splash

expo-haptics.behaviour: calls navigator.vibrate, which Chrome blocks until the person has tapped the page and Safari does not have
expo-haptics.fix: treat haptics as decoration that may not happen; never the only feedback

expo-background-task.behaviour: getStatusAsync() is 1 (Restricted); no task ever runs

expo-task-manager.fix: register no task on the web

expo-updates.behaviour: a stub: isEnabled is true and checkForUpdateAsync() reports noUpdateAvailableOnServer; a web deploy is the update
expo-updates.fix: never decide on isEnabled alone on the web; skip the update flow there

expo-clipboard.behaviour: works through the async Clipboard API, which needs a focused page and the person's permission (a call from a background tab is denied)
expo-clipboard.fix: copy only from a press handler and handle the rejection

expo-sharing.behaviour: uses the Web Share API: needs a press, https, and a browser that has it; files support varies
expo-sharing.fix: fall back to copying a link when isAvailableAsync() is false or the share rejects

expo-network.behaviour: getNetworkStateAsync() answers type UNKNOWN with isConnected from navigator.onLine
expo-network.fix: never branch on the connection type on the web

react-native-audio-api.behaviour: an AudioContext starts suspended until the person interacts with the page (autoplay policy)
react-native-audio-api.fix: resume the context from a press handler

@shopify/react-native-skia.behaviour: the module loads, but drawing needs CanvasKit (WebAssembly) loaded first with LoadSkiaWeb or WithSkiaWeb; only the import was verified
@shopify/react-native-skia.fix: load CanvasKit before the first canvas renders (skia-canvas-rendering owns the canvas kit)

expo-sqlite.behaviour: alpha on the web: needs wasm in Metro's assetExts, cross-origin isolation headers, an asynchronous warm-up before any synchronous call, and one tab at a time

expo-image-picker.behaviour: a file input; permissions answer granted

expo-crypto.behaviour: Web Crypto; digests need a secure context (https or localhost)

expo-localization.behaviour: from the browser; measurementSystem, currencyCode, uses24hourClock and firstWeekday are null

expo-linking.behaviour: createURL builds an https URL on the site's origin

expo-constants.behaviour: expoConfig comes from the app config at export time

expo-web-browser.behaviour: opens a new window or tab

expo-font.behaviour: @font-face; static rendering preloads fonts loaded synchronously

react-native-keyboard-controller.behaviour: loads; KeyboardController.dismiss() does nothing; the browser moves focused fields into view itself

@sentry/react-native.behaviour: loads; only the import was verified (crash-reporting-and-observability owns the web set-up)

specPatterns.behaviour: the web bundle refuses React Native internals: Importing native-only module on web
specPatterns.fix: import from 'react-native' only, or move the file to a .native.ts variant

missingExports.$comment: Exported by react-native 0.86.3, absent from react-native-web 0.21.3: the import is undefined in the browser and the first use throws.

missingMembers.$comment: Members react-native 0.86.3 types and react-native-web 0.21.3 leaves undefined: calling one throws TypeError in the browser.

silentMembers.$comment: Present on the web but doing nothing, so the feature silently disappears there: the checker fails them like missing members.

wrongMembers.$comment: Present on the web but answering wrongly for every visitor, so code that decides on them takes the wrong branch: the checker fails them like missing members unless a Platform.OS check keeps them off the web or a .web sibling replaces the file. Each value says what the browser answers.

AccessibilityInfo.isScreenReaderEnabled: always resolves true (react-native-web 0.21.3 cannot ask the browser), so every visitor counts as a screen-reader user

I18nManager.isRTL: is undefined, so the layout direction reads as left-to-right for every language
I18nManager.getConstants: answers isRTL: false for every language
I18nManager.forceRTL: does nothing (the page direction comes from the dir attribute of <html>)
I18nManager.allowRTL: does nothing (the page direction comes from the dir attribute of <html>)

differentBehaviour.$comment: Present on the web but answering differently (references/rn-api-gaps.md); documented, not failed.
differentBehaviour.AccessibilityInfo.isReduceMotionEnabled: the prefers-reduced-motion media query; true when there is no matchMedia
differentBehaviour.Vibration.vibrate: blocked until the person taps the page; missing in Safari
differentBehaviour.BackHandler: no hardware back: the browser's back button walks the history
differentBehaviour.StatusBar: renders nothing; its static setters do nothing
